notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
- Decreased the volume of the alarms so they don't burst your ears when going off
- Removed doors for 2 reasons:

 Players found it annoying and repetitive to look for keys every time they encounter a door
 The A.I. had various bugs when encountering doors which can ruin the whole game experience 

This change will now allow the player to access the whole map without having to be forced to look for keys to progress.

Currently Working on


 Voice Acting for the player character and the doctor
 I am working on ways to make encountering the doctor more of a challenging and scarier experience

notes.title: Update Notes for Patch 1
notes.content:
Patch 1 is now live and with it comes a few changes:

- The game now runs in Unreal Engine 5
- Increased the doctor's attack speed
- Made various changes to the map to slow down pacing
- Improved Shadows
- There are now 9 notes spread around the map that will help players uncover the story of what 
   happened at the Asylum
- Added 2 new animations that trigger when the doctor reacts to noise
- Changed Main Menu appearance

Future updates

- The next update will be focused on adding voice acting for the player character

notes.title: Next update for Madman
notes.content:
FUTURE UPDATES

Greetings mad folk! MadMan has been released for a week now and I have received a lot of valuable feedback to help me improve the game. Your feedback will be taken to heart and will be addressed in the next upcoming update. While on the topic of updates I would like to announce that I am working on a new update that will greatly increase game length, add several new levels to the game, expand on the story plus much more! When the next update comes out MadMan will be running on the new Unreal Engine 5, which will bring several new technical improvements to the game including better performance, enhanced visuals and less memory usage. I hope that you all are excited for what is to come, it will be worth it. Stay safe everyone.

- Nethersoft Interactive
